judged_text: The `embeddable_hosts.cmd_tuples > 0` guard is dead for a SELECT in PostgreSQL (cmdTuples is only populated for DML), so the INSERT block never runs while the paired `DELETE FROM site_settings WHERE name IN ('embeddable_hosts', 'embed_category')` always executes. Every existing installation silently loses its configured embeddable host list and embed_category setting with zero rows migrated to embeddable_hosts — the feature appears blank after deploy and the old config is unrecoverable (P0 data loss).
